blocks.task_summary: Sketch y=1/(x^2-2x-3), giving asymptote equations, local extremum coordinates, and axis intercepts.
method_path: Factor denominator to get vertical asymptotes x=-1, x=3
Determine horizontal asymptote y=0 from degree comparison
Find local max x-coordinate via axis of symmetry x=1 or f'(x)=0
Sketch three branches with correct asymptotics and key features
accepted_alternatives: Use derivative f'(x)=0 instead of axis of symmetry for local max

evidence.basis: y-intercept (0,-1/3) A1; vertical asymptotes x=-1 and x=3 A1; horizontal asymptote y=0 A1; valid method for x-coordinate of local max (M1); local max (1,-1/4) A1; three correct branches A1

blocks.task_summary: For g(x)=1/(x^2-2x-3), x>3, show g^{-1}(x)=(1+sqrt(x^2+4x))/x and state domain of g^{-1}.
method_path: Interchange x and y in g: 1/(y^2-2y-3)=x
Reject negative branch since original domain x>3 requires y>3
State domain of g^{-1} as x>0 from range of g
accepted_alternatives: Solve xy^2-2xy-(3x+1)=0 by quadratic formula and simplify to same result

evidence.basis: M1 for interchanging x and y; M1 for completing the square/using quadratic formula; A1 for (y^2-2y-3)=(y-1)^2-4; A1 for (y-1)^2=1/x+4; A1 for y-1=+/-sqrt((1+4x)/x); R1 for rejecting negative sign using x>3
domain of g^{-1} is x>0 A1
